title: Panelica External API
description: HMAC-SHA256 authenticated REST API for server management and integrations

auth.description: All authenticated requests require X-API-Key, X-Timestamp, and X-Signature headers

categories.name: CloudFlare
categories.description: CloudFlare DNS, cache, SSL, and zone management

categories.name: Core
categories.description: Core API endpoints for health checks and API key info

categories.name: Domains
categories.description: Domain management including subdomains and configuration

categories.name: License
categories.description: License status, features, quotas, and plan info (read-only)

endpoints.description: Returns all full and incremental server backups.
List all CloudFlare zones with settings (security_level, ssl_mode, always_use_https). Returns zone list with Panelica domain matching and IP sync status.

query_params.name: credential_id
query_params.description: Optional CloudFlare credential ID for multi-account

endpoints.description: Enable or disable CloudFlare development mode. When enabled, bypasses cache for 3 hours.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: true to enable, false to disable

endpoints.description: List all DNS records for a CloudFlare zone.
Create a new DNS record in a CloudFlare zone.

fields.name: type
fields.description: DNS record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT)

fields.name: proxied
fields.description: Whether traffic is proxied through CloudFlare

endpoints.description: Delete a DNS record from a CloudFlare zone.
Update an existing DNS record in a CloudFlare zone.
Enable or disable automatic HTTPS redirect (Always Use HTTPS) for a CloudFlare zone. When enabled, all HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: true to enable HTTPS redirect, false to disable

endpoints.description: Purge CloudFlare cache for a zone. Send purge_everything:true to purge all, or files array for specific URLs.

fields.name: purge_everything
fields.description: Set true to purge all cached files

endpoints.description: Get CloudFlare zone settings including security_level, ssl_mode, and always_use_https.
Set CloudFlare SSL/TLS encryption mode. Options: off (no encryption), flexible (CF-to-origin HTTP), full (CF-to-origin HTTPS, self-signed OK), strict (CF-to-origin HTTPS, valid cert required).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: SSL mode: off, flexible, full, strict

endpoints.description: Sync the Panelica server IP to the root A record of a CloudFlare zone. If an A record exists, it will be updated; otherwise a new one is created with proxy enabled.
Enable or disable CloudFlare Under Attack mode. When enabled, shows a JavaScript challenge to all visitors for 5 seconds.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: true to enable Under Attack mode, false to disable

endpoints.description: Returns API health status. No authentication required.
Returns current rate limit status for the API key.
Lists files and directories in a given path.
Returns all 27 license features with their enabled/disabled status.
Check if a specific license feature is enabled. Returns 404 if feature not found.
Returns detailed license plan information including plan slug, name, status, and expiry.
Returns all 6 resource quotas with current limits (domains, databases, ftp, email, subdomains, users).
Check quota limit for a specific resource. Returns 404 if resource not found.
Returns current license validity, plan name, expiry date, and grace period info.
Returns system metrics collected directly from OS.
WebSocket endpoint streaming compact metric frames (same field names as /v1/metrics/native) every ?interval seconds (1-30, default 2). Auth via ?ticket= from POST /v1/metrics/ws-ticket.
Returns a short-lived single-use ticket for GET /v1/metrics/ws. Browsers cannot send HMAC headers on a WebSocket handshake, so streaming auth is ticket-based.
Issues a Let's Encrypt SSL certificate for a domain.
Uploads a custom SSL certificate and key.
Restarts a specific service (nginx, apache, mysql, postgresql, redis, bind, proftpd, etc.).
Starts a specific service that was previously stopped.
Stops a specific service. Use with caution.
WebSocket endpoint for terminal access. ROOT only. Send JSON messages: {type:'input',data:'command'}, {type:'resize',cols:80,rows:24}
